name: Cardiff

neighborhoods.name: Cathays
neighborhoods.homes: Victorian terraced houses let as student shared houses

housing: Cardiff's rentals are largely Victorian terraced houses, many let as shared student houses, plus modern flats in the city centre and Cardiff Bay.

localRules.text: Every private landlord letting a home in Wales must register with Rent Smart Wales, and a landlord who manages the home themselves (or their agent) also needs a licence.
Deposits in Wales must be put in a government-backed tenancy deposit scheme within 30 days of the landlord receiving them.

tenantHelp.name: Shelter Cymru
tenantHelp.what: free housing advice charity in Wales

climate: Photograph any damp, mould and condensation on walls and window frames; Cardiff's mild, wet climate makes these the most common disputes.
fact: Cathays is one of the UK's densest student areas, so many Cardiff tenancies start in summer for the academic year.
